body.description: Legalize deck with finished floor 10'-0" above grade and 42" guardrails within the buildable area and set back from the west (left) property line by 3'-0".  Legalize small access stair to deck (3'-0" wide with 5 risers) projecting 4'-6" into the required rear yard, a permitted obstruction per Section 136(c)(14). Deck has plan dimensions of 13'-8" by 8'-8". Deck does not require notice per ZA Bulletin No. 4 (deck exemptions 3 and 4) because it is 10'-0" or less in height and would not require a firewall because it is set back 3'-0" or more from any property line.  If DBI finds that a firewall is required, the project will need to be routed back to Planning for 311 notification. The ADU proposed under BPA 202005308025 is in no way related to this scope of work. No change of use. No other work.
